summary: Incept AI is a voice-AI vendor for restaurant drive-thru and phone ordering, founded January 2024 by Umut Isik and Justin Foster; its core technical differentiator is proprietary audio-cleanup tech that improves speech recognition accuracy in noisy drive-thru environments. (Scope note: Exact publication date within the article not independently confirmed beyond the year.)
Incept AI raised $3 million in pre-seed funding (announced February 2025) to build out its voice-AI product for real-world (noisy) audio environments.
Incept AI integrates directly with Toast POS, pushing orders taken via its voice AI straight to Toast's Kitchen Display System or POS, per Toast's own support documentation for the integration.

Incept AI claims over 97% AI-only order completion for drive-thru and phone orders, versus an industry average it cites as 83%. (Scope note: Vendor-supplied performance stat relayed by press, not independently audited.)
